key_insight: An AI-derived focal TIL score captures localized immune infiltration on routine lung adenocarcinoma pathology images and was associated with overall survival after immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy.
clinical_relevance: The score may support future prognostic biomarker research in lung adenocarcinoma, but this study does not establish its ability to guide treatment selection.
method: Detect lymphocytes on H&E images using a deep learning model trained with immunohistochemistry-derived ground truth.
Segment tumor and adjacent stroma using a model trained on consensus pathologist annotations.
Quantify tile-level lymphocyte density across scorable tissue to capture spatial heterogeneity.
evidence_signal: Analytical validation yielded lymphocyte detection CCC=0.90 and segmentation Dice=0.87; among 685 ICI-treated patients, the focal TIL score was associated with overall survival (HR=0.60, 95% CI 0.48–0.75; P<0.001), with reported prognostic performance exceeding PD-L1.
watch_item: An association within an ICI-treated cohort does not establish prediction of treatment benefit; independent prospective validation is needed before clinical implementation.
paper_title: Quantifying Localized Tumor-Infiltrating Lymphocytes by Deep Learning on H&E Images: Analytical Validation and Prognostic Value in Lung Adenocarcinoma
